items.html: And what the Atik illuminates at first — that is this; for in the three heads it is found, and its bone is seen in them without any partition. But in this it shines through the hairs alone. And this is prior to this light, and it is the beginning of what is revealed, for although it is covered, since it is the first of what is revealed below — for in ZA this Hochma is revealed, and it spreads into the thirty-two paths — the name 'beginning' is justified in it, for it is the beginning of the Hochma that is revealed in ZA. And that is what it says: 'the beginning of what is revealed,' and it does not say 'the beginning which is revealed.' Not so the Concealed Hochma, which is not revealed at all, as above. And it was made into three heads, and one head includes them; and they are Hochma, Bina, and the Mazal that includes them. And know that this Mazal was made from it into literally one head that includes Hochma and Bina.
